hook: Vans Built a *Custom Acura SUV* To Match a Sneaker
dek: Vans and 28-year BMX pro Coco Zurita unveiled a sneaker and matching Acura ADX concept.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: Vans and pro BMX rider *Coco Zurita* unveiled a one-of-a-kind sneaker and custom Acura SUV.

slides.label: Who's Involved
slides.text: Zurita has been a pro BMX rider for *28 years* and a Vans athlete just as long.

slides.label: The Shoe
slides.text: The Vans Authentic features a *checkerboard* print, inside-out tag, and translucent soles showing more checkerboard underneath.

slides.label: The Car
slides.text: The 2026 Acura ADX *'CZ-77 Concept'* uses Vans performance fabric and carbon-fiber aero parts inspired by the shoe.

slides.label: Custom Details
slides.text: Widened fenders, 19-inch Rotiform wheels, Sparco seats, and a rear rack built to hold Coco's BMX bike.

slides.label: Vans' BMX Roots
slides.text: Vans is known for skating, but it's backed BMX riders and built pedal-ready shoes for *nearly 50 years*.

slides.label: Drop Dates
slides.text: The car debuts at Vans HQ in Costa Mesa on *October 24*, 9 AM to noon. Shoes drop the next day on Vans.com.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: It shows niche athlete communities, like BMX, can still drive major brand collabs when loyalty runs deep.

cta_line: Go see the *CZ-77 Concept* in person.
question: Shoe or car, which drop do you want more?
first_comment: Fun fact: the car's rear structure was built just to hold Coco's actual BMX bike.

caption_instagram:
Vans just teamed up with 28-year BMX pro Coco Zurita to drop a one-of-a-kind sneaker and a custom 2026 Acura ADX 'CZ-77 Concept,' and it's one of the wildest brand collabs we've seen this year.

The shoe is a checkerboard-covered Vans Authentic with translucent outsoles and an inside-out tag. The car matches it piece for piece: Vans performance fabric, carbon-fiber aero parts, widened fenders, 19-inch Rotiform wheels, Sparco seats, and a custom rear rack built just to hold Coco's BMX bike.

Vans has quietly backed BMX riders for nearly 50 years while everyone associated the brand with skating. This project puts that loyalty on full display. The car shows at Vans HQ in Costa Mesa on October 24 from 9 AM to noon, and the shoes drop October 25 on Vans.com.

Vans and professional BMX rider Coco Zurita just released a collaboration that goes beyond a typical sneaker drop: a checkerboard Vans Authentic shoe paired with a custom 2026 Acura ADX called the 'CZ-77 Concept.'

The build matters because it's a brand backing a niche, under-marketed community. Vans has supported BMX athletes for nearly 50 years, yet the brand is almost always associated with skateboarding. Zurita has ridden for Vans his entire 28-year career, and this project turns that long-term relationship into a tangible product: Vans performance fabric on the car, carbon-fiber aero parts, custom Sparco seats, and a rear structure built specifically to hold his bike.

For founders and operators, it's a reminder that deep, long-term partnerships with athletes or creators in overlooked niches can produce bigger opportunities down the line. The car debuts at Vans HQ in Costa Mesa on October 24, and the shoes release October 25 on Vans.com.
